class FeedForwardBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.layer1 = nn.Linear(256, 128)
        self.layer2 = nn.Linear(128, 256)
        self.layernorm = nn.LayerNorm(256)
    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.layer1(x)
        x = torch.relu(x)
        x = self.layer2(x)
        x = self.layernorm(x)
        return x

class FeedForwardBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(256)
        self.linear1 = nn.Linear(256, 128)
        self.linear2 = nn.Linear(128, 256)
    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = self.linear1(x)
        x = self.linear2(x)
        return x
